_comment: Clip W1 (b) (recording_shot_list.md): approach the wall at ~30 deg into it, airborne, one neutral wall jump on contact.
Same wall as W1 (a). The start is a few cm off the wall with an incoming normal component, so the jump happens
with the into-wall velocity still present (a start already touching would let the collision clip it first).
Set start.vel_mps from the video just before the jump (Godot frame: forward is -Z, up is +Y, +X is into the wall).
As written: 611 u/s (15.52 m/s) at 30 deg into the wall. Move the jump tick to the contact tick.
h_along / h_across are relative to the incoming direction (align.ref_window, before the jump), not the wall.
Model comparison (the point of (b)): fixed wall_jump_normal_mode 0 (set the normal axis to the kick) vs 1 (add).
Also note the frame of any sudden speed loss on contact (K49 backtrack kill).
Alignment: first rising crossing of vel_v through value_u (the wall jump) in video and sim.
Bounds are search limits, not game limits: a result on a bound is flagged in the report.
name: Angled neutral wall jump (W1b)
